text: I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your symptoms better, could you please tell me your age and if you have noticed any swelling in your abdomen or joints?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. Has she had any recent infections, and have you noticed any bleeding from her gums or nose? I also need to know if she has had any weight loss or night sweats.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Doctor
text: The symptoms of fatigue, bruising, fever, and severe bone pain in a 4-year-old are highly suspicious for acute leukemia, particularly acute lymphoblastic leukemia. I need to confirm the presence of blood abnormalities and potential bone marrow involvement. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Differential. REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Smear.
